titulo: NASA Competition Invites Students to Help Imagine a Future Enabled by Lunar Technologies
cuerpo: NASA is asking U.S.-based collegiate teams to submit bold, original concepts to the 2027 edition of a student challenge focused on aerospace innovation that could help the agency envision a future on the Moon shaped by new technology.
